matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the inconsistency between the gap condition in Theorem 2.1 (4‖E‖ ≤ δ_p) and Lemma 3.1 (δ_p > 5‖E‖). Pred_id 2 directly identifies this inconsistency, noting that Lemma 3.1 states δ_p > 5‖E‖ while Theorem 2.1 assumes 4‖E‖ < δ_p, and that the proof uses 4‖E‖. This is the same defect despite the verifier not having the exact original wording.

GT2 concerns ambiguous notation in Theorem 2.3 regarding whether the maximum is over the boundary or interior of Γ₁. Pred_id 4 identifies notation inconsistency in Theorem 2.3, noting that ∂Γ₁ (boundary) is used but Γ₁ was defined differently earlier. While the specific mechanism differs slightly, both identify problematic notation ambiguity in the same theorem statement about the contour Γ₁.
